answers.text:
Dear Ms Farrow,

I am writing you about a course which I am accepted for it, and I want to ask a small change of my working hours.

Firstly, the course is about the accounting program that we use in our office. It start in the next month and it continue for three month. The lesson is in the Tuesday and the Thursday morning, from nine o'clock until half past eleven, in the college near the station. My place is already confirm by the college.

Secondly, please change my working hour in this two days. I must come to the office at twelve o'clock instead of eight o'clock, because the college is twenty minutes far from our building. In the other three days everything can stay same like now.

Thirdly, about my work, don't worry, I will do everything like before and nothing will be late.

I think this course is very useful also for the company, because after it I can prepare the monthly reports faster and with less mistake. I hope you accept my demand.

Thanks a lot,

Kerem Aydin

why_this_band.task_response: The course and the requested change of hours are given as concrete figures, but the third point drops to a single wish sentence: there is no plan at all for how the work will be covered, only don't worry is said. The imperative please change and the closing Thanks a lot break the semi-formal register expected when writing to a manager.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: Firstly / Secondly / Thirdly are mechanically laid over the points, and the third paragraph finishes in a single sentence. The course–request–work order is still logical, though, and the reader can follow what is being asked.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Vocabulary is everyday and repetitive: course, work, hour keep recurring, and the only phrase belonging to a letter is I am writing. Demand is used in place of request, and forms such as twenty minutes far, less mistake stop the reader for a moment.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: Almost every sentence has an error: writing you, which I am accepted for it, it start, for three month, in the Tuesday, is already confirm, in this two days, stay same like now. Structures are simple sentences and short reasons added with because.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Actually write the third point: state concretely where the morning tasks would move to during the day and who would take them over. Switching from please change to I would like to ask and from Thanks a lot to Kind regards would also settle the register.

answers.text:
Dear Ms Farrow,

I am writing to ask for a change in my working hours for the next three months, because I have been accepted on a short training course.

The course is called Financial Reporting for Small Firms and it is given by the college near the station. It takes place on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, from nine until half past eleven, and it will start on 3 March and finish at the end of May. Unfortunately these hours are exactly the same with our normal starting time, so I cannot attend without your permission.

I would like to begin work at twelve o'clock on this two days and to stay until seven in the evening instead of four. On Monday, Wednesday and Friday my hours would not change at all, so I would still work the same number of hours in a week.

I have also thought about my daily tasks. The supplier invoices which I normally check in the morning can be done in the afternoon, and I have already spoken with Deniz, who is agree to answer the accounts line until I arrive. I will also read my messages before to leave the college.

I believe the course would help our team, because it covers the new reporting rules which we will have to follow them next year. I would be very grateful if you could consider my request.

Kind regards,

Kerem Aydin

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are addressed: the course is introduced with its name and hours, the change is requested with a time given, and how the work would be covered is explained with two concrete solutions. The course's benefit to the company stays in a single sentence, not developed enough to strengthen the request.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: The paragraph split is logical and each paragraph carries a single point. Links do not go beyond familiar patterns such as Unfortunately / I would like to begin / I have also thought, and the transition between the opening and closing sentence is a little flat.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: Items suited to the letter and the field of work, such as I would be very grateful if you could consider my request, supplier invoices, attend, permission, are present. In places such as the same with, who is agree, the collocation does not quite settle.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: Relative clauses and the conditional pattern are correctly formed, and long sentences do not fall apart. About half the sentences have a preposition, agreement or demonstrative error (the same with, on this two days, who is agree, before to leave, follow them next year); meaning is never blocked.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Most errors cluster in the same place — prepositions and demonstratives. A read-through before sending that checks only these (on these two days, who has agreed, before leaving) would move the grammar up one band.

answers.text:
Dear Ms Farrow,

I have been offered a place on a short training course starting next month, and as the sessions fall inside our working day, I would like to ask whether my hours could be adjusted while it runs.

The course, Financial Reporting for Small Firms, is run by the college on Station Road and consists of two morning sessions a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays from nine until half past eleven. It begins on 3 March and ends in the last week of May, so the arrangement I am asking about would cover roughly twelve weeks.

On those two days I would like to start at half past twelve rather than eight, and to work through until seven in the evening. My hours on the other three days would stay exactly as they are, which means my weekly total would be unchanged and no overtime would be involved.

As for the work itself, the supplier invoices I usually check first thing can be dealt with in the afternoon without holding up the payment run, and Deniz has kindly agreed to cover the accounts line on those two mornings. I will look at my messages between sessions and deal with anything urgent before I leave the college.

The course covers the reporting rules that come into force next January, so I hope it would be of some use to the department as well. I would of course be happy to discuss it, or to look at a different arrangement if the one I have suggested is awkward for the rota.

Kind regards,

Kerem Aydin

why_this_band.task_response: All three points are complete: the course's name, days, date range and duration are given; the change is requested with a time and it is stated that the weekly total stays the same; how the work would be covered is solved by both task and name. The suggestion of an alternative arrangement in the closing leaves the decision with the manager.
why_this_band.coherence_cohesion: Five paragraphs carry the logic of the letter: request, course, hours, work, closing. Transitions such as As for the work itself change direction without drawing attention, and no paragraph drifts to a second topic.
why_this_band.lexical_resource: There are less common items suited to letter register and the work context: fall inside our working day, holding up the payment run, come into force, cover the accounts line, awkward for the rota. In one or two places the emphasis lands a little heavy.
why_this_band.grammatical_range_accuracy: A conditional structure, a relative clause and the passive are used correctly and naturally; error-free sentences are close to all of them. The first sentence of the second paragraph feels a little crowded because it carries three pieces of information at once.

answers.what_would_lift_it: Split the first sentence of the second paragraph in two: putting who runs the course separately from the days and hours would ease the rhythm. If the course's benefit to the department is given one more sentence in the final paragraph, the request settles fully into place.
